title: Founding shade + entrance

notes.heading: S0 · modest founding shade
notes.text: One young palm and dry scrub. No stone planter, flower court or paving. Full art/shadow envelope: 176 x 152 world units.

notes.heading: H1 · visible shack threshold
notes.text: A short worn-earth landing meets the right-hand doorway, not the centre of the plot. Marker is provisional; validate at Close.

notes.heading: Keep the founding town bare
notes.text: Hall 1 + 22 empty plots. No completed garden buildings, fountains, moving actors or new gameplay. Existing anchors and hit targets stay.

footer: PROPOSAL ONLY. Green dashed boxes reserve full art including shadows; they are NOT rectangular garden designs. Amber lines are connection guides, NOT final road art. Wall unchanged.

title: Mature courts + entrances

notes.heading: S1 · western community court
notes.text: Grouped palm shade + low planting on shared stone. Replace scattered accents, do not add a green belt. Full envelope: 288 x 184 world units.

notes.heading: S2 · eastern market refuge
notes.text: A smaller shade/flower pocket beside the trade quarter. Crown + cast shadow fit 220 x 192 world units. Keep both existing closed fountains.

notes.heading: H50 · stair-to-court landing
notes.text: Only 18.56 units separate Hall and Depot targets. No wide road squeezed between them. A shallow landing joins the civic floor laterally.

notes.heading: W50 · loading threshold
notes.text: Connect to the off-centre Warehouse entrance, not its crop centre. Short forecourt, bounded painted width, no neighbour crossing.

notes.heading: C50 · caravan front gate
notes.text: A short side connection, avoiding the Forester plot below. Normalized socket estimates need Close-view calibration before being trusted.

notes.heading: Freight yard · unresolved socket
notes.text: Several bays/stairs make one exact door uncertain. Keep the shared floor; do not invent an entrance. No wall/gate/phone fixes in this pass.

footer: PROPOSAL ONLY. Green = full-art reserve, not garden shape; amber = provisional entrance guides, not final roads. No game code or final art changed. Same desktop/Staggered endpoints.
